inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.imageAlt: An inspector photographs a piece of infrastructure while the Humanika agent accompanies her in the field, both focused on the same detail.

seo.title: AI visual inspection | Humanika
seo.description: Photo evidence logging and assisted report generation: describe findings by voice or chat and prepare drafts for review.

demo.title: How the agent documents an inspection
demo.description: Follow an inspector from a photo taken in the field to the draft visit report.

steps.title: Captures the evidence
steps.text: The inspector photographs a finding and dictates her observation.

steps.title: Logs the finding
steps.text: The agent describes the evidence and adds it to the record.

steps.title: Confirms with the inspector
steps.text: It shows what was logged so she can complete it.

steps.title: Prepares the report
steps.text: The draft is ready for human review.

chat.text: Photo sent: crack in the north wall, next to the stairs.
Logging the evidence…
Finding 3: vertical crack about 40 cm long in the north wall, next to the access stairs.
Would you like to add an observation about the risk?
Yes: it needs a structural review.
Added. I'm preparing the draft report with the 3 findings.
Draft report ready for review
